note: Cases reviewed on 12 November 2026 and deliberately left in no pattern, with the reason. Ruling 13 settled that no selector can close the orphan gap and that the route is hand assignment; 387 of the 405 orphans were assigned that day. An orphan that is not in this list is new work, not a settled exclusion. Eight more were added on 15 November 2026 after the two rebalance rounds: five bank-credit cases and two account-opening cases, which are the subject of two proposed new patterns not yet created, and one leaked-tender case (PwC/Ethiopian Electric Power) where the contracts went to the payer but no payment to anyone is shown. A fifth round on 15 November 2026 added 22 more: fifteen bank-credit cases and five account-opening cases for the same two proposed patterns, which now stand at about 24 and 8 cases rather than the 9 and 3 of that morning, and two cases where an insider acted for an outside company with no payment to them shown. A sixth round on 15 November 2026 added 28 more: twenty-four bank-credit cases and three account-opening cases for the two proposed patterns, which now stand at about 48 and 11 cases, and one secret bank takeover bought with the bank’s own money. Round seven (15 November 2026) assigned 196 of its 199 orphans to kickbacks_contracts_laws by hand and left three here: two power-theft cases and one where a crime network bought a state company's contract. Those three mark a shape the map has no pattern for - an outside party paying for enforcement to be dropped rather than for a contract.
